name: Dearborn River
blurb: Seasonal canyon trip from Highway 287 to the Missouri, ending at Mid Canon FAS. Plan a full day and arrange a shuttle.

sections.notes: About 19 miles according to the 2024 River Management Society trip plan, including about one mile on the Missouri. Arrange the shuttle before launching. The bridge approach can be muddy and deeply potholed; check current access and flows.

notices.title: Corrected start and finish
notices.text: This is the Highway 287 bridge–Mid Canon trip described by the River Management Society, approximately 19 miles. It does not start at Highway 200, and the take-out is downstream of the Dearborn–Missouri confluence. The 2024 full-day itinerary is planning context, not a measured travel-time prediction.
notices.sourceName: River Management Society — 2024 Dearborn day-trip plan

timing.note: The corrected Highway 287–Mid Canon trip crosses onto the Missouri. A reviewed flow/speed calibration for that trip has not been established.
